Interface IInputType

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Input
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents an input type abstraction for various input devices (keyboard, mouse, gamepad). Provides methods for copying, deadzone management, state retrieval, and device identification.

public interface IInputType : IEquatable<IInputType>, ICopyable<IInputType>
